data.rationale: The proposal gets the core goal right (Find a Park, then filter by activity or topic, then Search), but it navigates through a different entry point ("See All Parks & Search By Map" instead of the "Search by Activity or Topic" link), leaves out the optional state parameter, and calls the filter value singular when the true workflow takes multiple values. Its steps are mostly concrete enough to automate, but the vague "scroll to filters" step and the missing state input would need fixing.
